title: chrysothamnus leiospermus
intro: Chrysothamnus leiospermus, commonly known as purple sage or silver wormwood, is a flowering plant in the daisy family that is native to the southwestern United States. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of anxiety and insomnia. The therapeutic actions of Chrysothamnus leiospermus include its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce pain and inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of the plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
